title: Correct and complete the firstmate explainer page, citing source
summary: Retry of the rejected firstmate explainer job: fix what the page (built by `xtask site` from studies/firstmate-work-handling) gets wrong or omits, for newcomers who read only the page. The earlier rejection came from the verifier mutating its snapshot, which is not a repository problem, so this reading repeats the page fix and also applies the earlier minor findings.

defaults_applied.how: Each page fact cites a claim with a quote from the pinned source.
One focused change to the study content, touching code only if the page build needs it.
The site build and the workspace tests are run.
The earlier minor findings are fixed generally, not only for the instances they named.
Workspace tests, clippy and fmt must pass.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The audience is newcomers reading only the page; the independent readers who checked the source are the judges.
'Try again' means redo the page fix from the base, not the verifier-hardening proposal in the introspection.
The pinned firstmate source is readable to the producer and needs a fresh read to find facts that c1–c22 do not cover.
Claims are added only where the pinned source supports them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every changed firstmate fact in intro.json, claims.json and model.json is backed by a claim whose quote appears in the pinned firstmate source at the pinned commit. The CHANGELOG entry lists each correction and addition with the firstmate source path and lines.

The Start here section and transition cards state the failure and limit behaviour already in the claims: lock contention exits 1 without waiting, an unreadable capacity exits 1, relaunch failure restores the record, no retry or relaunch bound was found, and a missing session start leaves a close unreplayed. Merge authority is worded as the configured setting, and the 'ship' glossary entry is corrected.

The glossary entry 'exit 1' says only what claims c4 and c7 support (the lock and unreadable-capacity cases) and does not imply every refusal exits 1. 'captain' is not described with words no claim states.
Placeholder values in the model (guard 'none' with evaluator 'agent' on t5, t7, t8) are shown on the page as 'no guard applies', not as an agent-evaluated guard.

Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site --out <fresh dir inside the working directory>`. It exits 0 and writes index.html. Every cited claim id resolves and no intro element, glossary term or transition summary is uncited.
Run `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`. All pass.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes. If the intro structure changes, docs/design/explainer-site.md describes it.

out_of_scope: Changing Athena's verifier, its snapshot handling or hashing (not in this repository's deliverables)
Changes to records/, governance files or other studies
departures: The job needs a fresh read of the pinned source and has already failed once, so cost and time are raised and acceptance is lowered a little.
